content:
If you look up docs#Manifold.IsImmersionAt in the docs and open the equations, it currently tells you that IsImmersionAt is defined as some existential statement involving a universe parameter ?u.7 - that would give me the impression that there is a free universe parameter here, which we do not want. But there is not, if you look at the actual definition you can see that the existential statement is over types in Type u and u is the same universe level E'' lives in, as one would expect.

Is this a bug in doc-gen4 and should be fixed, or am I just misunderstanding something about how universes in the docs should be displayed?
@Anne Baanen You have been looking into documentation a lot lately. Can you say more about this?
https://github.com/leanprover/doc-gen4/blob/main/DocGen4/Process/DefinitionInfo.lean#L27 probably this should not be fresh mvar levels

This is a bug in doc-gen4, I assume here in Process/DefinitionInfo.lean where new universe parameters are created and applied to the name, there might be a missing assignment step or something? (Note that the rendering engine for doc-gen will be replaced with Verso in the near future.)
Oh I see that Henrik was a bit faster than me!
I think the line you linked is fine and should not yield meta universe levels but the one I linked introduces meta ones
